setup_logger: create a logger with optional file output, color formatting, and distributed rank support for multi-worker training
log_first_n: log a message only for the first n occurrences using caller or message as the deduplication key
log_every_n: log a message once every n calls from the same caller location to reduce log spam
log_every_n_seconds: log a message no more than once per n seconds to throttle repeated logging from the same caller
review_ColorfulFormatter: review the _ColorfulFormatter class that adds colored WARNING and ERROR prefixes and abbreviates logger names
